messages:
Elaine: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands  a few pipeline and partner Qs. Drop short replies so we can capture action items.

Devon: Can we confirm the Q3 bookings ramp target used for AE quotas? I heard two numbers in the meeting.

Elaine: Q3 bookings ramp = $9.5M net new ARR. Thats the planning number for quota setting.

Priya: Are we still focusing priority reps on (1) developer platforms and (2) mid-market ISVs?

Elaine: Yes. Primary focus: developer platforms + ISVs in NA. Secondary: enterprise renewals and strategic health care pilots in EU.

Gabe: For partner-led deals  do we require a co-sell registration before committing to discounts? Some AE teams are unsure.

Lena: Short: yes, co-sell registration required to unlock partner discount and MDF. Ops will publish the registration form.

Devon: Any updates on partner enablement materials? We need one-pagers for SIs and an onboarding checklist.

Lena: OpsBot will publish the checklist + SI one-pager tonight in the shared drive.

OpsBot: Published: /internal/g2m/partner-enablement/si-onboarding-v1.pdf and /internal/g2m/partner-checklist.csv

Priya: For pricing clarity: what discount SKUs should AEs reference for pilot vs production? Im seeing conflicting guidance in the playbook.

Elaine: Pilot: use Hosted trial credits or a 3-month Dedicated pilot SKU (pilot-tier). Production: Dedicated tiered discounts (commit slabs) or standard hosted volume discounts. Maria is drafting a one-line chart, ETA EOW.

Gabe: Can product confirm the ETA for GA of the partner analytics dashboard? Sales needs that to forecast influenced pipeline.

Elaine: Products GA target slipped slightly; current ETA is mid-Q4. Product will share a short status note.

Priya: Action items I care about: 1) Single-row discount reference (Maria), 2) SI one-pager (Ops), 3) Co-sell registration link (Lena). Can we get owners + due dates?

Lena: Owner tags: Maria (discount reference)  due Friday EOB; Ops (SI one-pager)  published today; Revenue Ops (co-sell form)  link by tomorrow noon.

Devon: One more ask for leadership: any flexibility on short-term pilot SLAs (latency targets) for strategic logos? Some deals require <100ms P95 and were not there yet.

Elaine: Good flag. Product & eng to assess. If a deal requests SLA exceptions, flag here and tag me + EngOps so we can triage.

Gabe: Noting a potential big logo (conf call tomorrow). Ill post specifics if it becomes material.

Elaine: Thanks all. Ill consolidate these notes and create Asana tasks for the three main deliverables. Please forward any extra context or risky commitments into this thread before EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
